description: How the parties in an employer's occupational health and safety lifecycle relate to each other on the platform: how HR data triggers surveillance, how nurses and physicians run and document examinations for employees, how fitness opinions and restrictions reach line managers without medical content, how exposure profiles, hazardous situations and accident declarations flow between prevention advisers, line managers and HR, how the service coordinator plans capacity and proves activity, and how Kitry's consultants implement, migrate, update and support each customer.

relationTypes.name: Commercial
relationTypes.description: Subscriptions, hosting tiers, implementation and support engagements and renewals between the parties

relationTypes.name: Operational
relationTypes.description: Examinations, convocations, reports, declarations, corrective actions and delivery work

relationTypes.name: Financial
relationTypes.description: Licence and hosting fees, services fees, insurance and compensation flows

relationTypes.name: Information
relationTypes.description: Employee data, exposure profiles, fitness status, statistics, regulatory updates and advice

relations.name: Keeps employee, contract and assignment data flowing
relations.description: Synchronises workers, contracts, assignments, sites and workstations from the HRIS so that the surveillance rules derive the required examination type and periodicity and the convocations are triggered automatically for every new hire, transfer and return.

relations.name: Plans surveillance capacity and periodicity targets
relations.description: Sets the compliance targets per site and category, allocates physician and nurse capacity, opens appointment slots and follows the backlog so that every required examination is delivered within its legal periodicity.

relations.name: Runs intake, screenings and pre-visit preparation
relations.description: Prepares the consultation day: checks questionnaires, captures audiometry, spirometry, vision and biometric measurements from connected devices, runs nurse visits and intermediate visits, and files everything into the medical file before the physician's slot.

relations.name: Convokes, reminds and enrols in campaigns
relations.description: Sends convocations and SMS and e-mail reminders, offers online slots, pushes pre-visit questionnaires and invites employees to vaccination and health-promotion campaigns through the portal.

relations.name: Attends the examination and completes questionnaires
relations.description: Books or reschedules the visit, fills in the pre-visit questionnaire privately, attends in person or by secure teleconsultation, and exercises consent or opposition rights over access to the medical file.

relations.name: Issues fitness opinions and restrictions without medical content
relations.description: Delivers the fitness-for-work opinion, restrictions and accommodations to the line manager through the manager portal, showing clearance status and what to apply on the floor while the medical content stays in the confidential file.

relations.name: Coordinates restrictions, absence and return-to-work
relations.description: Shares the administrative outcome of examinations — fitness status, restrictions, follow-up dates and return-to-work conditions — so that HR can adapt assignments, plan absence and organise the return visit without seeing medical data.

relations.name: Provides exposure profiles per workstation
relations.description: Maintains the risk assessment, exposure groups, chemical inventory and measurement campaigns that give every workstation its exposure profile, so that the physician knows which surveillance category and which examinations apply and records exposure history in the file.

relations.name: Advises on collective prevention and occupational disease signals
relations.description: Turns individual findings and collective health monitoring into prevention advice, alerts on clusters, suspected occupational diseases and exposures to control, and contributes to accident analysis and the annual prevention plan.

relations.name: Reports hazardous situations from the floor
relations.description: Raises hazardous situations, near misses and inspection findings from the field with photos and location, so that the prevention adviser assesses them, updates the risk assessment and assigns corrective actions.

relations.name: Assigns corrective actions and prevention measures
relations.description: Allocates corrective actions from the action plan, audits and inspections to the line manager with deadlines and evidence requirements, and follows them to closure on the floor.

relations.name: Reports accidents and confirms assignment and attendance
relations.description: Records work accidents with circumstances, witnesses, injuries and first care in the manager portal so that HR is notified at once and the 48-hour or 8-day declaration clock starts at the event, confirms the worker's presence, assignment and working hours for the declaration, and reports back on the accommodations applied for restricted or returning workers.

relations.name: Feeds accident and occupational disease declarations into analysis
relations.description: Declares work accidents and occupational diseases on the national forms (CERFA/Ameli, Fedris, insurers) and shares the events and absence data that the prevention adviser analyses for root causes, frequency and severity statistics.

relations.name: Supplies activity data for the annual report
relations.description: Provides examination counts, fitness opinions, restrictions and collective health indicators from the medical file so that the coordinator proves the service's activity and compliance to the employer, the works council and the authorities.

relations.name: Implements the platform and manages the account
relations.description: Runs functional assessment, configuration, project management, data migration, training and change management for the go-live, then acts as dedicated account manager for renewals, module expansion and support escalation.

relations.name: Pays subscription, hosting and services fees
relations.description: Funds the annual SaaS subscription per module and workforce size, the shared or dedicated HDS hosting tier and the implementation, migration and training services out of the occupational health service's budget.

relations.name: Sets up HRIS synchronisation and migrates legacy data
relations.description: Configures the HRIS connector, SSO and import mappings with HR, migrates employee, exposure and historical medical data from legacy systems without loss, and trains HR on declarations and the manager portal.

relations.name: Delivers regulatory and product updates
relations.description: Keeps the customer's configuration current with FR/BE/LU/NL regulatory change — DMST and DUERP rules, national forms, ISO 45001 evidence — and communicates release notes and training for new safety and reporting features.
